passive.name: Burning Up
passive.description: When an enemy affected by Fan the Flames damages Pyrrha, she gains Elemental Essence. When Pyrrha dies, she deals 10 Affliction damage to all targetable enemies.
passive.note: Slot-0 passive authored as two reactive triggers (see hero.triggers); it is not a static aura. Matches the shipped, type-checked reference content/heroes/pyrrha.ts and content/test/pyrrha.test.ts.

triggers.note: 'When an enemy affected by Fan the Flames damages Pyrrha, she gains Elemental Essence.' eventSource = the attacker, eventTarget = the unit hit (must be Pyrrha).
'When Pyrrha dies, she deals 10 Affliction damage to all targetable enemies.' Reference authors 'all targetable enemies' as {faction:'enemies'} (living enemy team).

skills.name: Fan the Flames
skills.note: 'Using this skill on an affected enemy will refresh the duration' — applyStatus refreshes a same-named dot by default (DEFAULT_STACK_POLICY).

skills.name: Feed the Fire
skills.note: 'Deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy affected by Fan the Flames. Pyrrha heals 10 HP and gains Elemental Essence.' Damage is gated on the burn; the heal + Essence are unconditional (test-confirmed).

skills.name: Pyrokinesis
skills.note: 'Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy. If the target is affected by Fan the Flames, they take 5 more damage from it for the rest of its duration.' Wraith in White: 'using Pyrokinesis on an enemy will first use Fan the Flames' — the Fan the Flames effect tree is inlined ahead of the hit when Pyrrha bears the Wraith in White mark (not consumed; lasts the mark's 2 turns).

skills.name: Flashbang
skills.note: 'Stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Pyrrha becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.' Non-Strategic stun = scope {tag:'Strategic', mode:'except'} (stops all skills EXCEPT Strategic ones).

skills.name: Wraith in White
skills.note: 'Pyrrha ignores non-damage effects for 2 turns. During this time, using Pyrokinesis on an enemy will first use Fan the Flames.' The 2-turn Wraith in White mark is what Pyrokinesis reads to lead with Fan the Flames.

passive.name: Cinders
passive.description: When Jarrik damages an enemy marked by this skill, he deals 10 additional Affliction damage and gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Slot-0 passive, authored as a reactive damageDealt trigger (see hero.triggers). Blade of Dancing Lights extends this passive so that each proc while it is active also summons a Cinderling — that branch lives in the trigger, gated on Jarrik's Dancing Lights mark.

triggers.note: 'When Jarrik damages an enemy marked by this skill, he deals 10 additional Affliction damage and gains Elemental Essence.' The 'Cinders Proc Lock' mark is a self re-entrancy guard (an implementation detail, NOT from the oracle): the interpreter re-emits damageDealt for the rider's own 10 Affliction, which would otherwise re-proc up to the trigger depth cap. The lock is set before the rider and removed after, so the rider fires exactly once per Jarrik hit while still allowing separate hits (e.g. Cinderswell's multi-target) to each proc. The Dancing-Lights branch adds the auto-summon (from Blade of Dancing Lights). Minion-dealt damage (e.g. Cinder Splash) does not proc this because eventSource is the minion, not Jarrik.

skills.name: Blade of Ashes
skills.note: 'Deals 10 damage to target enemy and permanently marks them with Cinders.' 'Permanently' = round-scoped (duration null). Under Blade of Dancing Lights this base skill retargets to the whole enemy team; the AOE branch is gated on the caster's Dancing Lights mark. Damage lands before the mark, so the first hit on an unmarked enemy does not proc Cinders (the target is only marked afterward). jarrik:brimstone Brimsteel Scabbard arms a one-shot rider: +20 skill_damage_bonus (triple), uncounterableIf, a Cinderling summon gated on the target ALREADY bearing Cinders (the pre-strike branch at the top), and the consume branch below that clears the mark + bonus.

effects.note: Brimsteel Scabbard rider: 'if it strikes an enemy affected by Cinders, it automatically creates a Cinderling.' Checked BEFORE the strike applies Cinders (base note: damage lands before the mark), so it procs only when the target ALREADY bore Cinders from a prior hit, not from this strike's own mark.

The rider is one-shot: consume the Brimsteel Scabbard mark + its +20 skill_damage_bonus after the strike. The conditional Cinderling summon is handled up top (gated on a PRE-strike Cinders), so this branch only clears the rider.

skills.name: Cinderswell
skills.note: 'Deals 15 damage to all enemies. If any target is marked by Cinders, all enemies are Shattered for 2 turns.' Frozen targeting_type 'all' -> 'all-enemies' (the game's 'all' is a generic AOE; the oracle scopes it to enemies). Marked enemies also take the Cinders passive rider via the damage. The Shatter condition counts currently-marked enemies (Cinderswell removes no marks).

skills.name: Call Cinders
skills.note: 'Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies marked by Cinders. Those marks are then removed, creating a Cinderling minion for each mark removed.' forEach binds each currently-marked enemy (list resolved once, so mid-loop mark removal is safe): 5 Affliction (which also procs the Cinders passive while still marked), then remove the mark, then summon one Cinderling per mark.

skills.name: Wall of Sparks
skills.note: 'Grants Jarrik 15 Shield for 1 turn for each active Cinders mark or Cinderling minion.' Shield = 15 * (enemies bearing a Cinders mark + allied Cinderling minions).

skills.name: Blade of Dancing Lights
skills.note: 'Withdraws all active Cinders marks and consumes any active Cinderling minions. For a number of turns equal to the total consumed, Blade of Ashes targets all enemies and Jarrik will automatically create a Cinderling minion whenever he triggers his Cinders.' Order matters: the Dancing Lights mark is applied FIRST with duration = (Cinders marks + Cinderling minions) captured before they are removed; then marks are withdrawn from all enemies; then Cinderling minions are consumed (defeat). The Dancing Lights mark drives Blade of Ashes' AOE retarget (jarrik1) and the Cinders passive's auto-summon (jarrik0 trigger). Frozen targeting_type 'all' -> 'all-enemies' (its cross-faction reach is the enemy mark withdrawal; minion consumption is caster-side).

skills.name: Cinder Splash
skills.note: 'Deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy team, killing the Cinder minion.' The minion is its own caster, so {faction:'enemies'} = the opposing team; then it self-destructs (defeat self). This damage does NOT proc Jarrik's Cinders passive (eventSource is the minion, not Jarrik).

minions.name: Azure Sparkling
minions.note: jarrik:plasma Blue Flame Spirits replaces Cinderlings with Azure Sparklings. templateAlias 'Cinderling' makes base-kit template:'Cinderling' selectors (Wall of Sparks shield count, Blade of Dancing Lights duration count + defeat-consume) treat an Azure Sparkling exactly as the Cinderling it stands in for.

skills.name: Azure Splash
skills.note: jarrik:plasma Blue Flame Spirits re-skins Cinderling as a 10-HP plasma minion with the same Cinder-Splash behavior (10 Affliction to the enemy team, then self-destruct).

passive.name: Frost-Covered
passive.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enhancing his skills. If Gommar damages an enemy with reduced damage, he gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Frost-Covered is a self mark (duration null) his actives read via 'has mark Frost-Covered'. It is an enhance CHARGE: consumed when Gommar uses any active except Ice Body (gommar4), which re-grants it (and grants Essence if he already had it). Re-granted at round start by the passive. Absolute Zero self-stuns if he has no charge. 'reduced damage' = an enemy carrying a negative outgoing_damage_mod; the engine has no status-magnitude condition, so the trigger keys on 'has outgoing_damage_mod' (his -5 debuffs are the only base-kit source, always negative).

skills.name: Foot of the Mountain
skills.note: Frozen targeting_type 'all' refined to 'all-enemies' per the oracle ('the enemy team'). Frost-Covered branch stuns ONLY Strategic-tagged enemy skills (scope mode 'only').

skills.name: Breath of the North
skills.note: 'until the end of Gommar's next turn' = duration 1 (durations tick at the applier's turn-end). Frost-Covered branch makes the hit Piercing AND uncounterable. Conditional counter-immunity is a real primitive: gommar3 carries uncounterableIf:{has mark 'Frost-Covered' of caster}, which resolveDeclaration checks at skill-declaration (before the interrupt/counter path) so the hit is uncounterable exactly while Gommar is Frost-Covered. The -5 outgoing_damage_mod is applied unconditionally.

skills.name: Ice Body
skills.note: Frozen targeting_type 'single (defaulted)' -> 'self' (every effect is on Gommar). 'invulnerable to non-strategic skills' -> a tag-scoped invulnerable {tag:Strategic, mode:except} (blocks harmful skills WITHOUT the Strategic tag), honored by legalTargets. The essence branch is evaluated BEFORE Frost-Covered is (re)applied, so it reads the prior state ('if he was already Frost-Covered').

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.note: 'All enemies and allies' = {faction:'all'} (includes Gommar himself, whose non-Strategic skills are therefore among those stunned). The second clause adds a FULL stun (unscoped) to Gommar when he is not Frost-Covered ('he is also stunned' -> also loses his Strategic skills).

skills.name: Sovereign's Howl
skills.note: 'Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 2 turns' = a 2-turn normal dot (magnitude 10, duration 2); prose says 'for 2 turns' so no separate immediate hit. 'lowers the damage they deal by 5 permanently' = a permanent (duration null) outgoing_damage_mod of -5.

passive.name: Tales to Tell
passive.description: Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence whenever one of his allies does. Whenever this occurs, he gains 10 Shield.
passive.note: 'Tales to Tell' is Keeper's real Shield pool: gained with grantShield and read with ref:shield, so it still absorbs incoming damage like ordinary Shield. The engine exposes grantShield but NO shield-SPEND primitive, so each 'attempts to consume N Shield' (Page-turner, Character Development, Plot Armor, Hero's Return) is a guard `ref:shield >= N` followed by a custom `consumeShield` node -- the four customs. Modeling the pool as a plain `stack` would remove custom but lose the damage-absorbing property the oracle's word 'Shield' implies, so real Shield was chosen. The passive's essence-coupling fires on statusApplied; the engine has no event-status-kind condition, so it keys on eventUnit (an ally, not self) newly holding elemental_essence -- this over-fires only when an already-essenced ally receives some other status.

triggers.note: Lasting reaction armed by Chronicle Deeds (keeper3). The first time a marked enemy uses a skill during the watch, Tales to Tell gains 35 Shield and the mark is cleared. It lives on Keeper (not the passive) because effect trees cannot register triggers; it is inert until keeper3 applies the mark.

skills.name: Page-turner
skills.note: 'attempts to consume 25 Shield ... if he does' = guard ref:shield>=25, then custom consumeShield (no shield-spend primitive), then the payoff.

then.note: spend 25 Shield from Tales to Tell (Keeper's real Shield pool).

skills.name: Character Development
skills.note: Consume 25 Shield -> heal target ally 30. Same guard+custom pattern as Page-turner.

skills.name: Chronicle Deeds
skills.note: Arms an invisible one-turn watch on the target enemy: mark 'Chronicle Deeds', duration 1 ('this turn'). Keeper's hero-level 'Chronicle Deeds' trigger grants Tales to Tell 35 Shield if that enemy uses a skill during the watch. 'This effect is invisible' has no status primitive, so it is documented only.

skills.name: Plot Armor
skills.note: Consume 20 Shield -> target ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hero's Return
skills.note: Targets a DEAD ally (revive to:'target' — the revive op no-ops on a living unit). 'attempts to consume 75 Shield ... if he does' = guard ref:shield>=75, then custom consumeShield, then revive at 50 HP.

passive.name: Healing Tears
passive.description: Whenever River Daughter counters or stuns an enemy, she heals her team for 5 HP every turn for 3 turns. Whenever this occurs, she gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Static aura -> two hero-level reaction triggers (counterFired; stun applied by self). maxHp=100 assumed: no hero HP is stored in the frozen data; this is the genre-standard playable-hero HP and rulings confirm HP resets to full each round.

triggers.note: Passive part 1: whenever River Daughter counters an enemy, heal team 5/turn for 3 turns and gain Elemental Essence.
Passive part 2: whenever River Daughter stuns an enemy (she applies a stun), same reward. Discriminated by the target now carrying a stun status.

Lasting reaction placed by River Clone (invisible): negates the first Harmful skill declared by a River-Clone-marked enemy, then consumes the mark. The counter emits counterFired, which drives Healing Tears part 1.

skills.name: Ripple

effects.note: Base 10 AoE + any Catalytic Nova bonus (riverdaughter:current adds +10 per cast, stacking); the stack is consumed below. Non-current forms never hold it, so this is +0 for them.

skills.note: 10 to the enemy team; sets the Undertow Stun mark so Undertow stuns next turn (mark lasts 1 turn). Under Dive (Dive Ripple mark) Ripple 'lasts two turns' - modeled as a second 10 AoE scheduled for the following turn. AMBIGUITY: 'will last two turns' read as the AoE repeating once more.

skills.name: Undertow
skills.note: 20 to target. If Ripple set the Undertow Stun mark, also stuns target 1 turn (this stun feeds Healing Tears). Under Dive (Dive Undertow mark) hits all enemies; the stun still lands on the declared primary target.

skills.name: River Clone
skills.note: Invisible. Marks an enemy; the River Clone counter trigger negates that enemy's first Harmful skill (firing Healing Tears via counterFired). Under Dive (Dive River Clone mark) this skill's cost is re-denominated to 1 generic ([65]) instead of 1 water ([2]); the mark is consumed on use. Cost re-denomination is metadata, not an effect node, so it is documented here.

skills.name: Soothe
skills.note: Heals target ally 10/turn for 2 turns. After applying, if target is a Hero at full HP (missingHp==0) or below 60 HP, River Daughter gains Elemental Essence. 'Full HP' modeled as missingHp==0 (no maxHp ref exists).

skills.name: Dive
skills.note: Invulnerable 1 turn. Applies three 1-turn empowerment marks read by next turn's skills: Dive Ripple (Ripple lasts two turns), Dive Undertow (Undertow hits all enemies), Dive River Clone (River Clone cost becomes 1 generic).

skills.name: Corrosive Slam
skills.note: 'Deals 15 Affliction damage to the enemy team on the following turn. If this unit takes damage, this skill is cancelled.' Frozen Channel:false, so modeled with schedule (not the Channel class): on cast it marks itself with a permanent 'Corrosive Slam' pending mark and schedules the AOE for its following turn (delayTurns:1, matching Dive Ripple's 'following turn'). The scheduled payload lands only if the pending mark still exists, and self-removes on fire. The minion's damageDealt trigger strips the mark whenever the Slime takes damage, cancelling the pending strike; the Slime dying also cancels it (scheduled entry finds no live caster). Mark is duration:null (not 1) so tickDurations does not expire it before fireScheduled runs in the same turn-end.

passive.name: Oceans Gather
passive.description: When Zev'kir reaches 1 stack of Call Tides, he gains Elemental Essence. When he reaches 2 stacks, his harmful skills will stun their primary target for 1 turn. When he reaches 3 stacks, his skills affect all valid targets.
passive.note: Threshold passive. Clause 1 is a hero trigger (Essence on reaching 1 stack); clauses 2 and 3 are state read at skill-use time and are implemented inline in every active skill. maxHp=100 assumed: no hero HP is stored in the frozen data (genre-standard playable-hero HP; HP resets to full each round per rulings).

triggers.note: Passive clause 1: on reaching 1 Call Tides stack, gain Elemental Essence. Clauses 2 (>=2 stacks: harmful skills stun primary 1 turn) and 3 (>=3 stacks: skills hit all valid targets) are state read at skill-use time and are implemented inline in each active skill.
Call Tides stacks are consumed when Zevkir uses a non-Strategic skill. Fires after the skill resolves so damage/duration/threshold logic reads the stacks first, then they are cleared.
'Bubble Prison will end if Zevkir is stunned' - when a stun lands on Zevkir, clear the Bubble Prison DoT from all enemies.
Lasting reaction placed by Repulse (invisible): negates the first Harmful skill received by the Repulse-marked ally, consumes the mark, and makes Zevkir begin channeling Call Tides.

skills.name: Call Tides
skills.note: Channel (indefinite): each channel turn Zevkir gains 1 Call Tides stack (permanent until consumed). Using any other skill interrupts the channel; using a non-Strategic skill also consumes the stacks (see Call Tides consumption trigger). Reaching 1 stack grants Essence via Oceans Gather.

skills.name: Riptide
skills.note: Damage = 5 + 10 per Call Tides stack. Oceans Gather: >=2 stacks stun primary target 1 turn; >=3 stacks hit all enemies. Stacks consumed after use.

skills.name: Bubble Prison
skills.note: Deals 15 damage each turn for (1 + Call Tides stacks) turns (DoT). Ends if Zevkir is stunned (see Bubble Prison trigger). Oceans Gather: >=2 stacks stun primary 1 turn; >=3 stacks hit all enemies. Stacks consumed after use. INTERPRETATION: 'X damage for N turns' read as a per-turn DoT (genre idiom plus the 'ends if stunned' leash implies a maintained effect).

skills.name: Repulse
skills.note: Invisible. Places a counter on target ally (Repulse mark); the Repulse trigger negates the first Harmful skill that ally receives and then makes Zevkir begin channeling Call Tides. Oceans Gather: >=3 stacks affects all allies. Repulse is non-Strategic, so using it consumes Call Tides stacks.

skills.name: Tidal Wave
skills.note: 45 piercing to target. The specific [water] cost is reduced by 1 per Call Tides stack (min 0): a costMods entry of -stackCount('Call Tides') on generic, which spills onto the specific-5 base (floored at 0) since generic is 0. The {generic:0,specific:5} shown is the 0-stack cost. Oceans Gather: >=2 stacks stun primary 1 turn; >=3 stacks hit all enemies. Stacks consumed after use.

passive.name: Well-Used Panic Button
passive.description: The first time Saya falls below 40 health due to damage, her next Stroke of Genius will detonate all of her inventions, dealing 10 Piercing damage to a random enemy and granting her 10 Shield for each device detonated.
passive.model: hero trigger on damageDealt that ARMS Stroke of Genius
passive.note: Two parts. (1) The damageDealt trigger arms a 'Panic Armed' mark the first time post-damage hp<40 (self-gated by 'Panic Armed'/'Panic Spent' since react-triggers don't honor once). (2) Stroke of Genius (saya5) reads that mark and detonates. Devices = Saya Coils (stack on Saya) + Spider Mines (stack on enemies). deviceCount aggregates coil stacks + stackSum of Spider Mine across enemies (total mines, correct even when multiple mines pile on one enemy across casts). Per-device 10 Piercing is aggregated onto one random enemy (frozen 'a random enemy', singular); shield is 10*deviceCount.

triggers.note: Arms the next Stroke of Genius the first time Saya is dropped below 40 HP by damage this round.

Ongoing half of saya1: while the 'Universal Energy Conduit' mark is up, a random ally gains Elemental Essence at the end of SAYA'S turns. eventTeamIsSelf scopes it to team A's turn-end (turnEnd fires for both teams).

Ongoing damage of saya2, fires 'at the end of every turn' (both teams' turn-ends — correct). Normal coils tick 10 each, Enhanced coils tick 20 each, aggregated onto one random enemy. Each coil's per-hit base is +statusMag(coil_damage_bonus)*totalCoils — 0 unless the saya2 'Link Coils' augment is drafted, which sets coil_damage_bonus=5 so each coil deals +5 per active coil (quadratic, per the augment note).
Detonation half of saya3: when a mine-bearing enemy uses a new skill, their mine deals 15 and is consumed (one mine per skill use).
Enhanced half of saya4: while the 'Plasma Charge' mark is up (set only when Plasma Shield is cast while Enhanced), any damage to Saya's shield grants her Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Universal Energy Conduit
skills.note: Cast installs the 'Universal Energy Conduit' mark that drives the turn-end essence trigger. Enhanced: also lower a random ally's skill costs by 1 generic ([65]=generic icon) for 1 turn (targeting is 'self' but the oracle says 'targeted ally' — resolved to a random ally), then consume Enhanced.

skills.name: Saya Coil
skills.note: Constructs a coil (a stack on Saya); the 'Saya Coil' turn-end trigger deals its damage. requires-gate enforces the max of 3 active coils. Enhanced makes THIS coil deal double, tracked as an 'Enhanced Saya Coil' stack (ticks 20), then consumes Enhanced. 'Bypassing' class kept as a tag; left as normal damage (no glossary to confirm what it bypasses).

skills.name: Spider Mines
skills.note: Constructs 2 spider mines (3 while Enhanced), each attaching to a random enemy hero as a 'Spider Mine' stack; the 'Spider Mines' skillUsed trigger detonates them. Enhanced is consumed on cast.

skills.name: Plasma Shield
skills.note: Self-buff (frozen targeting is 'single', effect is self). 40 shield + scoped affliction damage_ignore for 1 turn (the exemplar type-scoped immunity in ENGINE_GAPS). 'This skill is invisible' = the deferred cosmetic isHidden flag, noted only. Enhanced sets the 'Plasma Charge' mark that powers the shieldDamaged->Essence trigger, then consumes Enhanced.

skills.name: Stroke of Genius
skills.note: Gains Essence; re-denominates her other skills to cost '1 lightning' ([3]=lightning icon); Enhances her next skill (the 'Enhanced' mark that skills 1-4 read and consume). If armed by the passive ('Panic Armed'), it detonates all inventions: 10 Piercing/device to a random enemy + 10 shield/device, then clears the devices and marks 'Panic Spent'. The cost re-denomination is the ONE custom node — there is no set-cost / change-cost-type primitive (cost_mod is only an additive magnitude delta); ENGINE_GAPS tracks 'skillId-scoped cost_mod with Value' as debt.

effects.note: changes the costs of her other skills to 1 lightning; no DSL primitive sets cost value/type.

minions.name: Saya Cell

skills.name: Divert Charge
skills.note: 'Target Hero gains Elemental Essence. After using this skill, the Saya Cell minion dies.' Grants the target the one-shot Elemental Essence charge, then the Cell defeats itself via the native defeat op (bypasses shield/DR, no self-damage).

minions.note: Battery fusion (saya:battery) minion. Summoned 1-at-a-time by the Saya Cell fusion skill (sayabattery1, template "Saya Cell").

minions.name: Shady Assistant

skills.name: Busy Work
skills.note: 'Reduces the cost of Saya's skills by 1 Generic for her next 2 turns.' Global cost_mod (magnitude -1, no skillId) on the summoner (Saya) for 2 turns; the -1 delta applies to generic, spilling to specific per the cost engine. targeting kept as frozen 'single'; effect pinned to 'summoner'.

minions.note: Reanimation fusion (saya:reanimation) minion. Summoned each round by the Shady Assistants fusion passive (sayareanimation0, roundStart summon template "Shady Assistant").

minions.name: Saya-Brand Monstrosity

skills.name: Mad Mash
skills.note: 'The Monstrosity deals 40 damage to target enemy.' Normal-type damage.

skills.name: Embedded Restoration
skills.note: 'Heals the Monstrosity for 15 HP.' Self-heal; the Monstrosity is the caster (frozen sayareanimationminion3, targeting self).

minions.note: Reanimation fusion (saya:reanimation) minion. Summoned by the Saya-Brand Monstrosity fusion skill (sayareanimation1, template "Saya-Brand Monstrosity").

passive.name: Stored Charge
passive.description: Ando's skills Charge him, granting him Elemental Essence and augmenting his skills for 1 turn. Using a skill while Charged will Supercharge him, granting him Elemental Essence and further augmenting his skills for 1 turn.
passive.note: Charge state = two exclusive marks on Ando: 'Charged' then 'Supercharged' (each duration 1, so the augment window lasts 1 turn per DURATION_ANCHOR). The passive is the 'Stored Charge' skillUsed trigger: after Ando finishes any skill it advances his state one step (none->Charged->Supercharged) and grants Elemental Essence on each real step (no step / no essence once already Supercharged). Each active skill reads its CURRENT Charged/Supercharged mark for its augmented branch (skillUsed fires AFTER effects resolve, verified scheduler.ts:413,427). Two per-use opt-out marks encode skills that manage their own charge: 'chargeHandled' (Expel/Focus/Overclock -> passive skips auto-advance) and 'noOverclockConvert' (Focus/Overclock -> Overclock's convert trigger skips them). ENGINE_GAPS.md calls this exact self-augmentation pattern a 'false gap' — plain if/forEach reading own state.

triggers.note: Active only while the 'Overclock' window (duration 3) is up. After Ando uses a Supercharged OFFENSIVE skill he drops back to Charged and gains Essence instead of losing charge. Strategic setup skills (Focus Power, Overclock itself) tag 'noOverclockConvert' to opt out so their own cast does not immediately undo the Supercharge.

skills.name: Electroblade
skills.note: Charged branch: mark the target then strike EVERY Electroblade-marked enemy for 15 (single hit each; marking first folds the primary target into the sweep). Supercharged branch: hit all enemies for 15, +10 to those already marked (read before this cast marks them), then mark all. Charge advance is applied afterward by the Stored Charge passive.

skills.name: Flash Step
skills.note: Base Shatter lasts until end of Ando's next turn (duration 1). Charged adds a turn (duration 2). Supercharged is treated as 'further augment' = Charged's +1 duration AND retargets to every Electroblade-marked enemy. Advance applied afterward by the passive.

skills.name: Expel Energy
skills.note: Damage keyed off PRE-cast charge: Supercharged -> 30 Piercing, Charged -> 20 normal, else 10 normal. Then it removes Ando's charge state and tags 'chargeHandled' so the passive does NOT advance it. 'Cannot be stunned' -> the Unstunnable tag, which isStunnedFor honors (castable even while Ando is stunned).

skills.name: Focus Power
skills.note: Advances charge in-effect (so the 'afterwards' clause can read the NEW state), tagging 'chargeHandled' (passive won't re-advance) and 'noOverclockConvert' (Overclock won't convert this Strategic cast). If now Charged: 5 Piercing to all Electroblade-marked enemies. If now Supercharged: mark a random enemy hero with Electroblade.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.note: Castable only while Supercharged (requires-gate, per ENGINE_GAPS ando5). Extends the current Supercharge by 1 turn and opens the 'Overclock' window (duration 3) that powers the convert trigger. Tags 'chargeHandled' + 'noOverclockConvert' so this cast neither auto-advances nor self-converts.

passive.name: Biting Wind
passive.description: Any time an enemy unit becomes invulnerable, Zephyrex deals 15 piercing damage to them first.
passive.note: Static reactive aura, authored as a hero-level trigger. Fires when an enemy gains the invulnerable status; the 15 piercing damage resolves BEFORE the invulnerability takes hold (the word 'first' in the oracle), so it is not blocked. Synergizes with Arcadian Duet, which makes an enemy invulnerable.

skills.name: Arcadian Duet
skills.note: Making an enemy Invulnerable triggers Biting Wind (15 piercing first). Durations are 'until the end of their (the target's) next turn'; encoded as 1. autoTargetMark forces this onto an Ominous Rumble-marked enemy when one exists (zephyrex:storm), and the marked-hit branch CONSUMES the mark only. Elemental Essence on a marked hit belongs to Jolt (zephyrexstorm1), not Arcadian Duet — its frozen text grants no Essence.

effects.note: Ominous Rumble (zephyrex:storm): Arcadian Duet auto-targets a marked enemy and 'consumes the mark in the process' — consume ONLY. Elemental Essence on a marked hit belongs to JOLT (zephyrexstorm1), not Arcadian Duet; its frozen text grants no Essence.

skills.name: Elegant Sweep
skills.note: Channeled DEFERRED payload: the 25 piercing lands ONLY on the following turn, not on cast. The engine runs a channelTurns:1 skill's effects on cast AND on the following-turn channel tick, so ONLY the damage is gated (other on-cast effects an augment appends -- e.g. Polite Denial's Wind Step DR grant -- still fire on cast). The gate fires the 25 when Zephyrex is channeling zephyrex2 (the following-turn tick, since the channeling status is applied AFTER the cast-turn runEffects) OR when an instant_cast override for this skill is active (angel Light of Raphael, which suppresses the channel and lands the hit immediately on cast). Interruptible - being stunned or using a new skill cancels it (Channel class; doesNotInterrupt intentionally absent).

skills.name: Sonic Thrust
skills.note: Bypasses Invulnerability (Bypassing tag): the 20 piercing lands even on an invulnerable target. Usable ONLY while Wind Step (zephyrex4) is on cooldown: a requires:{skillOnCooldown:'zephyrex4'} castability gate (the condition reads the caster's own zephyrex4 currentCd > 0).

skills.name: Wind Step
skills.note: The damage_reduction buff is Invisible to the opponent (invisible:true; no dedicated visibility primitive exists). The conditional 'if Zephyrex receives a new skill during this time he gains Elemental Essence' uses a custom node: the DSL trigger EVENTS list has no 'skill received' event, so the 1-turn window is handled by the escape hatch.

effects.note: No skillReceived trigger event exists; grants Elemental Essence if Zephyrex is granted a new skill while the (1-turn) Wind Step DR window is active.

skills.name: Perfect Execution
skills.note: Ramps permanently (round-scoped, duration null): a 'Perfect Execution' stack increments each use, so damage = 15 * stackCount (15, 30, 45, ...). 'Perfection' is a 1-turn mark; if it lapses (onExpire) it applies the round-permanent 'Perfection Locked' mark, which the requires clause reads to disable this skill for the rest of the round. Re-using before expiry refreshes Perfection and keeps the skill live.

passive.name: Two as One
passive.description: Syl begins the game with a Hatchling Eagle minion. Any time Syl and her Eagle act on the same turn, she gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Implemented as three hero triggers: (1) roundStart summons a Hatchling Eagle (fresh each round); (2) when Syl uses a skill and (3) when her Eagle uses a skill, each stamps a duration-0 'acted this turn' mark and, if the other already acted this turn, grants Syl Elemental Essence. Whichever of the pair resolves second grants the essence; the marks clear at turn end.

skills.name: Feed
skills.note: Heals the Eagle (only allied minion in the base kit) for 20. 'At maximum life after the heal' is tested as missingHp == 0 (no maxHp Value ref exists). Feed may only target an allied minion (the Eagle) — targetKind restricts the pick.

skills.name: Skylance
skills.note: Base 20 piercing. If empowered by the Eagle's Swoop this turn ('Skylance Empowered' mark on Syl), deals an additional 15.

skills.name: To the Skies!
skills.note: Applies a duration-0 'To the Skies' mark to the Eagle for this turn. The Eagle's Talon Rake reads it (adds a 1-turn stun and +1 to its own cooldown) and its Soar reads it (invulnerability lasts +1 turn and re-extends this mark). Authored targeting 'self' - no manual target is picked; the empowerment is placed on Syl's Eagle.

skills.name: Unbreakable Bond
skills.note: Equalizes current HP between Syl and her Eagle (both set to their average). Uses a custom node: there is no atomic setHp/equalize primitive and no union selector for exactly {Syl, her Eagle}, so a primitive tree cannot compute-then-apply without the intermediate HP change corrupting the second unit's target value.

effects.note: Set Syl and her Eagle to the average of their current HP.

skills.name: Leyline Nest
skills.note: Advances the Eagle one growth stage in place (transform, keeping current HP into the higher-max template): Hatchling->Adult->Ancient; no effect once Ancient. Cost shown is the reset/full value: the wind-specific cost decreases by 1 each turn (min 0) and resets to 4 on use - handled by a hero trigger (see triggers) because the DSL has no per-skill dynamic-cost primitive.

triggers.note: Syl begins each fresh round with a Hatchling Eagle. origin 'innate' so the Eagle still summons after Syl fuses (fusion replace-mode drops base triggers, but every Syl fusion builds on the Eagle).

origin 'innate' so the Syl+Eagle same-turn Essence gain survives fusion (else fused Syl keeps her Eagle but loses this half of Two as One). Suppressed only while syl:mechanic's 'Aerie Essence Override' mark AND its shield both hold — mechanic owns essence-on-every-skill while shielded, and the base resumes when the shield breaks.

'self' is Syl (trigger owner); eventSource is her Eagle (her only base-kit allied minion, any growth stage). origin 'innate' so this half of Two as One survives fusion. Same Aerie-override+shield suppression as the Syl-acts trigger so syl:mechanic doesn't double-grant while shielded.

effect.note: Leyline Nest's wind-specific cost decreases by 1 each turn (floor 0) and resets to its base of 4 when the skill is used. No DSL primitive expresses per-skill dynamic cost. origin 'innate' so the cost mechanic survives fusion (else fused Syl's Leyline never decays — strictly worse). Storm suppresses this via a 'Leyline Decay Suppressed' mark (it replaces per-turn with per-essence decay); ghost suppresses it temporarily.

minions.name: Hatchling Eagle
minions.note: Starting stage of Syl's Eagle (template id sylminion). Growth is cumulative: Talon Rake (cd0) is retained through every stage so the Eagle can always act, satisfying Two as One (Soar alone has cd3 and would leave the Eagle idle).

skills.name: Talon Rake
skills.note: When empowered by To the Skies! (mark 'To the Skies' on this eagle), also stuns the target for 1 turn and increases its own cooldown by 1.

minions.name: Adult Eagle
minions.note: Second stage (template id syladultminion), reached via Leyline Nest. Gains Swoop while retaining Talon Rake.

skills.name: Talon Rake
skills.note: When empowered by To the Skies! (mark 'To the Skies' on this eagle), also stuns the target for 1 turn and increases its own cooldown by 1.

skills.name: Swoop
skills.note: Shatter lasts until end of turn (duration 0). Empowers Syl's Skylance (+15 damage this turn) via a duration-0 'Skylance Empowered' mark placed on the summoner (Syl).

minions.name: Ancient Eagle
minions.note: Final stage (template id sylancientminion), reached via Leyline Nest. Gains Soar while retaining Talon Rake and Swoop.

skills.name: Talon Rake
skills.note: When empowered by To the Skies! (mark 'To the Skies' on this eagle), also stuns the target for 1 turn and increases its own cooldown by 1.

skills.name: Swoop
skills.note: Shatter lasts until end of turn (duration 0). Empowers Syl's Skylance (+15 damage this turn) via a duration-0 'Skylance Empowered' mark placed on the summoner (Syl).

skills.name: Soar
skills.note: Makes this eagle and Syl (summoner) invulnerable for 1 turn. When empowered by To the Skies! it lasts an additional turn (duration 2) and extends the empowerment by re-applying the 'To the Skies' mark for another turn.

skills.name: Nettle Strike
skills.note: 'Deals 5 Affliction damage to target enemy.' The fusion clause that these count as Syl's Eagle for Two as One is a fusion-layer engine gap already noted on the sylfaerieminion summon, not part of this skill.

passive.name: Dennis the Apprentice
passive.description: At the start of each round, Hector summons Dennis the Apprentice. Whenever Hector uses a Serum skill on Dennis, he gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Authored as two hero triggers: a roundStart summon (guarded to avoid duplicating a living Dennis) and a skillUsed essence-grant. The essence trigger fires when Hector uses a skill on an ally other than himself (his only such skills are the Serum injections on Dennis) - the frozen data carries no distinct 'Serum' class tag to key on. Dennis's own passive (dennis0) is the authority that suppresses this summon and redirects every 'Dennis' reference to the hero Dennis when he shares Hector's team; that cross-hero rewrite cannot be expressed from Hector's side.

skills.name: Burning Blood Serum
skills.note: 'This effect stacks': a hidden stack counter drives both the outgoing-damage bonus (+10 per stack) and the self-dot (10/turn per stack), so each cast adds another +10/+10.

skills.name: Stoneseal Serum
skills.note: The regen is the boon; the cost_mod (+1, representing +1 Generic energy - cost_mod carries no element channel) is the removable drawback.

skills.name: Mindfog Serum
skills.note: 'ignore stuns and counters' = non_damage_ignore (the umbrella immunity that covers stun, a harmful non-damage effect) + uncounterable. The Mindfog mark gates Lumbering Smash's bonus stun on the minion. The '+1 cooldown for 3 turns' drawback has no StatusKind, so it is the one custom node.

effects.note: CUSTOM: no lasting cooldown-modifier StatusKind exists; models Mindfog's removable '+1 to cooldowns for 3 turns' drawback.

skills.name: Protect Me!
skills.note: Invisible skill (hidden from the opponent). Applies a 1-turn mark; the actual reflect is the mark-gated hero reflect trigger that redirects any Harmful skill declared on Hector to Dennis.

skills.name: Serum Overload
skills.note: Refreshes every Serum on Dennis back to 3 turns (durationDelta = 3 - remaining, a no-op when the serum is absent), strips each serum's negative half, and revives a dead minion-Dennis at 50 HP. The revive selector targets only a DEAD ally minion named Dennis, so it fires only 'if Dennis is dead and he was a minion when he died'.

effects.note: CUSTOM: clears the Mindfog cooldown-penalty custom status (paired with hector3's custom; no primitive removeStatus can target it).

skills.name: Lumbering Smash
skills.note: Base skill deals 10. While the minion carries the Mindfog Serum mark, it also stuns the target's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Synthesize Serum
skills.note: 'The Synthesizer stores a permanent copy of all Serums on the target that it does not currently hold.' For each of Hector's three Serums present on the target that the Synthesizer does not already hold, record a permanent stored-serum mark on the Synthesizer (dedup by serum type). Needs custom fn synthesizeSerum.

skills.name: Catalyze Serum
skills.note: 'The Synthesizer applies all of its stored serums to target unit.' For each stored serum, re-run the corresponding Hector serum skill effect on the target (via the summoner Hector's skills). Stored serums are permanent, not consumed. Needs custom fn catalyzeSerum.

passive.name: Pain Tolerance
passive.description: If Hector the Injector is on this Hero's team, Hector's passive won't create a minion at the start of the round, and all of Hector's skills that refer to Dennis will refer to this Hero instead. If Dennis is damaged, he will gain Elemental Essence and 5 Damage Reduction until the end of his next turn. This effect stacks, but does not refresh. Dennis can only gain Elemental Essence from this effect once per turn.
passive.note: Part A (Hector-teammate rewrite: suppress Hector's summon, retarget every 'Dennis' reference from the minion to this hero) is now ENCODED via Unit.understudyFor: buildMatch sets it to 'Dennis the Apprentice' when Dennis shares Hector's team, and resolveSelector admits this hero for any selector naming that exact template - so Hector's count-guarded roundStart summon sees count>=1 (suppressed) and his Protect Me! redirect + Serum targets resolve onto hero-Dennis. The understudy is a REFERENCE stand-in only: targeting/status/count/redirect selectors naming the template resolve to hero-Dennis, but structural minion-lifecycle ops (defeat/revive/transform/useSkill-by) do NOT admit it, so Hector's Perfect Form fusion cannot consume the hero, Serum Overload cannot revive him as a minion, and a Dennis-cast reference (Dennisyphus) no-ops since the hero lacks the minion's skills. Part B is the damageDealt trigger: a 'Pain Tolerance' stack drives cumulative 5xN Damage Reduction, duration 1 = 'until end of his next turn'. 'Stacks but does not refresh' is encoded exactly: each hit adds a PERMANENT (dur null) Pain Tolerance stack and schedules its OWN -1 at Dennis's next turn-end (delayTurns 1), so every stack expires on its own clock rather than sharing one refreshed duration-1 timer; DR is recomputed = 5 x live stackCount after each change. Elemental Essence is gated to once per turn by a self-expiring duration-1 guard mark.

effect.note: 'stacks, does not refresh': this hit's stack is removed one Dennis-turn later, independent of every other hit (a permanent stack + a per-hit scheduled -1, not one shared duration-1 timer). The DR is recomputed = 5 x live stackCount after the decrement.

skills.name: Big Green Fist
skills.note: 10 base + 5 per Pain Tolerance stack. The HS-46 Ascendant mark adds a further +10 (single hit), so the if/else picks the amount rather than dealing a second hit.

skills.name: HS-112 Fury Serum
skills.note: Applies a 4-turn Fury mark; the two mark-gated hero triggers Taunt (for 1 turn) any unit Dennis damages and any unit that damages him. Taunt/mark both refresh rather than stack, matching 'can not stack on enemies or Dennis'.

skills.name: HS-46 Ascendant Serum
skills.note: 'until the end of his next turn' = duration 1 (self-applied). The mark is read by Big Green Fist for its +10.

skills.name: Shared Agony
skills.note: forEach enemy re-deals 5 Piercing to Dennis, one hit per enemy (so Pain Tolerance stacks per enemy), each credited to its enemy via from:'it' — so Fury's 'unit that damages him' correctly taunts each attacking enemy, not Dennis himself.

skills.name: HS-88 Reconstitution Serum
skills.note: '(stacks)': a hidden stack counter grows the regen by 5 each cast; regen is round-permanent (no stated duration). Heals Dennis (caster).

skills.name: End of Shift
skills.note: Self-inflicts 25 Affliction, then inlines HS-112, HS-46 and HS-88 on himself via useSkill (each runs with Dennis as caster/self).

passive.name: Whimsy
passive.description: Titania's skills do not trigger effects with their use or damage.
passive.note: Static aura realized as permanent Stealth on Titania. Status kind 'stealth' is defined as 'does not trigger enemy effects', and the interpreter's stealthSuppressed() skips any enemy reactive trigger whose actor is stealthed - exactly 'her skills do not trigger effects with their use or damage.' Re-applied each round (duration null) via the roundStart trigger below.

skills.name: Thorn Prick
skills.note: '5 affliction damage permanently' = a permanent (duration null, round-scoped per the PERMANENT ruling) affliction DoT of 5/turn. NB: the current tickDots() guard skips duration===null dots, so under today's interpreter a null-duration DoT would not actually tick - flagged as a DSL-vs-interpreter tension; the DSL-correct transcription of 'permanently' is null.

skills.name: Laughing Powder
skills.note: Primary target: Strategic-only stun (2t) + the named 'Laughing Powder' affliction DoT (5/turn, 2t). The reactive spread ('anyone who uses a new skill on that character is afflicted by Laughing Powder for 2 turns') is the hero trigger sourced 'Laughing Powder': it fires on skillUsed when the acted-on unit holds the Laughing Powder DoT and re-applies that DoT to the actor. It excludes Titania herself (eventSource != self) so casting the powder does not powder the caster - skillUsed emits AFTER effects resolve, so the target already holds the DoT at that point. Spread propagates the affliction DoT only (the debuff literally named 'Laughing Powder'), not the strategic stun. skillUsed on multi-target skills only exposes the first target selector, so the spread keys on the primary target.

skills.name: Barbed Wit
skills.note: Taunt forces the enemy to target Titania (unitRef=caster) for 3 turns. The early-end clause ('ends if they use a new harmful skill on Titania') is the hero trigger sourced 'Barbed Wit', which removes the taunt when the taunted enemy uses a skill on Titania. The 'harmful' qualifier is not tag-checkable on skillUsed (that event carries no tags), but it is naturally satisfied: taunt only redirects Harmful single-target skills onto Titania, so a taunted enemy's action on her is the harmful retaliation the prose describes.

skills.name: Prance
skills.note: Titania gains Elemental Essence (a Prance gain -> +1 Prance stack, the counter Summer Clique reads). 'For one turn, the first unit to use a new skill on Titania gains Elemental Essence' = the 'Prance Watch' mark (duration 1 = one turn per DURATION_ANCHOR) plus the hero trigger sourced 'Prance': on the first qualifying skill used on Titania it grants that unit Elemental Essence, adds another Prance stack (the 'given' increment), and consumes the mark so only the FIRST unit benefits.

skills.name: Summer Clique
skills.note: Summons one Summer Courtesan per accumulated Prance stack (total Elemental Essence gains+gives via Prance), then resets the stack. Summon reads the stack before the reset. Prance stacks are round-scoped (duration null); 'this game' is realized as this battle, consistent with the engine's fresh-battle-per-round model (the same convention the frozen Channel Earth 'this battle' counter uses).

skills.name: Curry Favor
skills.note: Always heals Titania (the summoner) for 15 HP regardless of the chosen target. targeting kept as the frozen 'single'; the effect is pinned to 'summoner'.

passive.name: Yggdrasil's Bounty
passive.description: At the start of the game, Gaia creates two Seedling minions.
passive.note: Realized as a roundStart trigger summoning 2 Seedlings. Each round is a fresh battle (minions are cleared at round start and re-summoned by start-of-round passives - see startRound/removeMinionsWhere), so 'start of the game' is faithfully realized as start-of-each-round, giving Gaia her two Seedlings every battle.

skills.name: Sprout Seedling
skills.note: 'Maximum 3' caps living Seedlings; the summon is gated on the current count of allied Seedling-template minions being < 3.

skills.name: Worldfist
skills.note: Base 10 + 5 for each Channel Earth stack on Gaia. Each Seedling's Channel Earth adds a permanent 'Channel Earth' stack to its summoner (Gaia), so 'each time Channel Earth has been used this battle' = Gaia's Channel Earth stack count.

skills.name: Channel Vitality
skills.note: Heals the target ally 10 now and marks them. The hero trigger sourced 'Channel Vitality' heals every marked ally another 10 whenever an allied minion uses a skill ('if any of Gaia's minions act'). 'For the rest of the turn' is approximated by a duration-1 mark, the shortest expressible window under the applier-turn-end tick model (it can over-persist by one applier cycle). 'Gaia's minions' is approximated as allied minions, since the selector vocabulary cannot filter by specific summoner.

skills.name: Rampart
skills.note: 20 permanent Shield + 5 per Channel Earth stack. duration null = round-permanent Shield per the PERMANENT ruling.

skills.name: Worldmarch
skills.note: Transforms every active Seedling into a Worldsprout in place. keepHp omitted (defaults false) so each becomes a full-HP (40) Worldsprout, matching 'become Worldsprout minions permanently'. Transform retemplates without a death, so no on-death effects fire.

skills.name: Channel Earth
skills.note: Feeds the summoner (Gaia): grants Elemental Essence and +1 permanent 'Channel Earth' stack, which Worldfist and Rampart scale off.

skills.name: Vitality Transfer
skills.note: Heals the target ally for the Worldsprout's current HP, then the Worldsprout dies (defeat self, not damage). Heal resolves before the self-defeat so the pre-death HP is transferred.

minions.name: Gaia's Fury
minions.note: The minion is 'Gaia, Enraged' (Rising Indignation, Reading A: every Gaia's Fury minion is enraged): +10 dealt (outgoing_damage_mod) and +10 received (incoming_damage_mod), and Moon Spike (gaiafury2) is locked via requires:{not has 'Enraged'} — so it may not be used, per prose.

passive.name: Living Stone
passive.description: At the end of each of his turns, Roland gives 10 Shield to a random ally. If this Shield is broken, Roland gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Two hero triggers: a turnEnd shield grant, and a shieldBroken essence gain. The shielded ally is tagged with a round-permanent 'Living Stone' mark so Strength From The Earth (self bonus) and Stoneform (spread DR) can read who is 'affected by Living Stone'; the mark is cleared when that shield breaks. Hero HP not in frozen data; set to the standard 100 (matches the reference hero).

triggers.note: Fires at the end of Roland's OWN team's turn only ('each of his turns'), gated by eventTeamIsSelf (turnEnd fires for both teams).
Fissure starts each round with 2 turns of cooldown remaining. Round start resets all cooldowns to 0, so this re-applies +2.

skills.name: Strength From The Earth
skills.note: Target an enemy or a Boulder. Base 15, +10 while Roland himself is affected by Living Stone. If the target is a Boulder (Roland's ally minion) it then launches for its remaining HP at an Earth Pillar-marked enemy if one exists, else a random enemy, and is destroyed.

skills.name: Earth Pillar
skills.note: Mark duration 2 = Roland's next two turns. Shatter only if the struck target was already stunned.

skills.name: Stoneform
skills.note: Roland gains 15 DR for 1 turn; every unit currently affected by Living Stone also gains it. damage_reduction is single-slot, so re-applying to Roland only refreshes.

skills.name: Fissure
skills.note: Hits every unit other than Roland (allies, minions and enemies). Their Harmful skills are stunned for 1 turn. Starts each round on 2 cooldown (see the Fissure roundStart trigger).

minions.name: Boulder
minions.note: Inert projectile minion summoned by Form Stone; no skills or triggers of its own. Strength From The Earth strikes it, launches it for its remaining HP, and destroys it.

skills.name: Shambling Smash
skills.note: 'Using this skill does not deactivate Exile' is a Black Knight carryover — Exile is the Black Knight's passive (blackknight0), not a Roland mechanic — so the clause is a no-op for Roland's Zombie and needs no custom handler.

skills.name: Hurl
skills.note: Full frozen prose (three clauses): base 10; +20 if an ally Boulder exists, destroying one Boulder; +10 if the caster is affected by an Earth Pillar mark (reachable via the myth fusion's Earth Pillar, Spires of the North). Authored as ONE combined damage hit per branch (nested ifs) rather than three additive damage nodes, so the target takes a single instance (one DR pass, one damageDealt reaction) totalling 10/20/30/40; the Boulder is destroyed once when the +20 applies.

minions.name: Slimeball
minions.note: Body minion with no active skill of its own (no frozen skill references rolandslimeminion). Summoned two-per-Boulder by the slime fusion passive Oozeshaping (rolandslime0); made damage-immune fodder by Call to the Mire (rolandslime1) and launchable by Strength From The Earth — all of which live on Roland's fusion, not on the minion.

minions.name: Stonecap Mushroom
minions.note: Body minion with no active skill of its own (no frozen skill references rolandsporeminion; Loamwrecker rolandspore1 is Roland's fusion skill, not the minion's). Created on Boulder destruction by the spore fusion passive Scattered Spores (rolandspore0); consumed by Strength From The Earth for a 15 Affliction AoE + self-destroy, and counted by Loamwrecker — all on Roland's fusion, not on the minion.

passive.name: Revered Daughter
passive.description: Ayana gains 5 points of permanent damage reduction for each of her living allies.
passive.note: Dynamic aura: DR = 5 x (living hero allies, excluding Ayana), doubled while Cloister is active. Kept as a single round-permanent damage_reduction status, recomputed at round start and whenever an allied hero dies (and by Cloister). 'Allies' read as fellow heroes, not self and not minions. Hero HP not in frozen data; set to the standard 100.

skills.name: Voice of Light
skills.note: 15 damage to one enemy (all enemies while Chorus is active). The struck enemy is tagged 'Voice of Light'; if it deals new damage before the tag lapses, Ayana gains Essence (Voice of Light hero trigger). Tag duration 1 + Voice of Glory stacks.

skills.name: Chorus
skills.note: Frozen targeting_type was single(defaulted); modelled as self since it buffs Ayana's own skills. For Ayana's next 2 turns Voice of Light and Prayer hit all valid targets (a 'Chorus' mark, duration 2, that those skills read).

skills.name: Prayer
skills.note: Heal 10 to one ally (all allied heroes while Chorus is active). The healed ally is tagged 'Prayer'; if it takes new damage before the tag lapses, Ayana gains Essence (Prayer hero trigger). Tag duration 1 + Voice of Glory stacks.

skills.name: Cloister
skills.note: Frozen targeting_type was single(defaulted); modelled as self. Doubles Revered Daughter DR for 1 turn: applies a 'Cloister' mark (duration 1) whose onExpire recomputes DR back to single, then recomputes now (reads the mark, doubles). Same recompute as the passive.

skills.name: Voice of Glory
skills.note: Frozen targeting_type was single(defaulted); modelled as self. Permanently (round-scoped) adds 1 turn to how long the tags Voice of Light and Prayer place last; stacks each cast. Those skills set their tag duration to 1 + stackCount('Voice of Glory').

minions.name: Angel
minions.note: Body-only minion (no own skill). Ayana's fusion passive Choir On High (ayanaangel0) summons two Angels; while either is alive Chorus is permanent, and the passive's alive-count selector reads these bodies. Providence (ayanaangel1) is Ayana's angel fusion active, not the Angel's skill.

passive.name: Protector of the Song
passive.description: When Taryn has an ability reflected to him, he gains 10 DR for 1 turn and Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Authored as a react trigger on skillRedirected granting self 10 damage_reduction (1 turn) + elemental_essence, gated on eventRedirectedToSelf (the reflect destination == Taryn). This is exactly "an ability reflected TO HIM": it fires iff the skill is redirected onto Taryn (including his own skill reflected back onto him) and never on a foreign reflect that redirects to a non-Taryn unit. Zero custom used.

triggers.note: Passive reward. See passive note for the gating limitation.

Realizes 'any Harmful skill used by the [Banner-marked] target is reflected to Taryn'. Permanent hero trigger gated by the 1-turn 'Banner of Harmony' mark that taryn1 applies to the enemy (no dynamic-trigger op exists, so reflection must be a standing trigger keyed to a mark). The not-sameUnit guard stops the redirect re-bouncing once the target is already Taryn.

Realizes Stalwart Shield's 'reflects all harmful skills from the [ally] target to himself' (same protective-redirect pattern as blackknight4). Gated by the 'Stalwart Shield' mark taryn4 places on the protected ally; fires when a Harmful skill is declared against that ally and pulls it onto Taryn. `has ... of eventTargets` inspects the declared skill's first target (single-target harmful is the norm).

Realizes Refrain's ally branch: 'healed for 15 whenever they use a skill for 2 turns'. The 2-turn 'Refrain' mark is applied by taryn2; this standing hero trigger heals the mark-bearer 15 each time they use a skill.

Realizes 'any ally who uses a new harmful skill on the [Inspiring-Thrust-marked] target will gain Elemental Essence.' isFaction is relative to the trigger owner (Taryn), so eventSource=ally means Taryn's team. Mark lasts 1 turn ('this turn'). Note: because taryn3 emits skillUsed after applying the mark, Taryn's own Inspiring Thrust cast can itself satisfy this and grant him Essence — a minor literal-vs-forward-looking edge (no skillId condition exists to exclude the setup cast).

skills.name: Banner of Harmony
skills.note: 'Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, any Harmful skill used by the target is reflected to Taryn.' The mark drives the standing 'Banner of Harmony' reflect trigger.

skills.name: Refrain
skills.note: 'Targets one enemy or ally. If enemy: stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn (scoped stun, tag Harmful, mode only). If ally: they are healed 15 whenever they use a skill for 2 turns' — the ally case sets the 'Refrain' mark read by the 'Refrain' heal trigger.

skills.name: Inspiring Thrust
skills.note: 'Deals 20 damage to target enemy. This turn, any ally who uses a new harmful skill on the target will gain Elemental Essence' — the 1-turn mark drives the 'Inspiring Thrust' essence trigger. The trailing if is Radiant Glory's augment ('using Inspiring Thrust will also use Refrain on the target'); on an enemy, Refrain resolves its stun branch.

skills.name: Stalwart Shield
skills.note: 'May target Taryn or an ally. Grants Taryn 20 Shield, and if used on an ally, reflects all harmful skills from the target to himself. This skill's target is invisible.' Shield has no stated duration -> round-permanent (null). The ally reflect is realized via the 'Stalwart Shield' mark (applied only when target != self) that keys the standing 'Stalwart Shield' reflect trigger; its duration is unspecified in the oracle so modeled round-permanent (null). 'target is invisible' is a hidden-target presentation flag (isHidden), not a mechanic. The trailing if is Radiant Glory's augment ('using Stalwart Shield will also use Refrain on the target').

skills.name: Radiant Glory
skills.note: 'For 3 turns, using Stalwart Shield and Inspiring Thrust will also use Refrain on the target.' Modeled as a 3-turn self mark; the augment is realized as conditional useSkill(taryn2, on=target) branches embedded inside taryn3 and taryn4 (gated on this mark), rather than a skillUsed trigger, because no skillId-scoped trigger condition exists.

passive.name: Exile
passive.description: When the Black Knight acts alone, his abilities are enhanced and he gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: 'Enhanced' is not a global status (ENHANCED_AUGMENTED ruling); each Black Knight skill branches on its own condition, which here is 'acts alone'. Detecting 'acts alone' requires an acted-this-turn ledger the engine does not yet expose (explicit tracked gap in ENGINE_GAPS.md, which names blackknight0) — there is no faithful DSL proxy: it is action-based, not alive-count based (the Curse of Fealty fusion clarifies 'acting', not 'alive'). So a single custom fn maintains the enhanced state: it sets/refreshes a self mark 'Exile' (duration 1) and grants Elemental Essence when the Black Knight is the only ally taking an action this turn, and clears the mark otherwise. Every active skill then reads {has mark 'Exile'} with a plain if — the only custom node in this kit. The mark name is Black-Knight-private (not a shared 'Enhanced' status), consistent with the ruling. Attached to turnStart because skillDeclared react-triggers do not fire (declare phase runs only counter/reflect) and skillUsed fires after a skill's own effects.

args.note: Maintain the enhanced flag: if the Black Knight is the sole acting ally this turn, apply/refresh self mark 'Exile' (1 turn) and grant self Elemental Essence; otherwise remove mark 'Exile'. Requires the acted-this-turn ledger (tracked engine gap, ENGINE_GAPS blackknight0). Allies acting under Curse of Fealty are excluded from the count by that fusion, not here.

triggers.note: LAST-RESORT custom (the kit's only one): 'acts alone' cannot be read by any existing selector/condition/value because the acted-this-turn ledger is unbuilt. Everything downstream is plain DSL keyed on the resulting 'Exile' mark.

Realizes the enhanced clause of Dead or Alive: 'redirects harmful skills from his allies to himself.' Standing hero reflect trigger gated by the 1-turn 'Dead or Alive' mark that blackknight4 applies only while enhanced. isFaction is relative to the owner (Black Knight); the not-sameUnit guard both excludes skills already aimed at him and prevents redirect re-bounce.

skills.name: Oathbreaker Strike
skills.note: 'Deals 15 damage to 1 enemy. While enhanced, deals 10 more damage and becomes piercing.' Enhanced = acting alone = {has mark 'Exile'}. The outer branch is blackknight5's ultimate override ('during The Nightmare Rides, Oathbreaker Strike targets all enemies and is always enhanced') -> 25 piercing to all enemies.

skills.name: Misery
skills.note: 'For 2 turns, the Black Knight deals 5 additional damage for each 30 health his team is missing, up to 20. While enhanced, lasts an additional turn.' Bonus = min(20, 5*floor(teamMissingHp/30)) over the 3 heroes (allies incl. self). outgoing_damage_mod +N = dealer deals N more (normal/piercing). Duration 2, or 3 while enhanced (=mark 'Exile'). CAVEAT: the engine freezes status magnitude at apply time, so this snapshots team-missing-HP; the oracle's per-hit live re-scaling is a tracked gap (ENGINE_GAPS lists blackknight2 under live-scaling magnitude) — the authored Value formula is faithful; only its lazy re-evaluation is pending.

skills.name: Unholy Aura
skills.note: 'For 2 turns, all allies and enemies deal 5 less damage. While enhanced, this skill only targets enemies and affected enemies deal 10 less damage.' outgoing_damage_mod -N = deal N less (normal/piercing). Base hits every unit ({faction:'all'}); enhanced (=mark 'Exile') hits enemies only at -10. Skill-metadata targeting stays 'all' per the frozen targeting_type; the enhanced enemies-only retarget is handled in-effect.

skills.name: Dead or Alive
skills.note: 'The Black Knight ignores all new Harmful skills for 1 turn. While enhanced, also redirects harmful skills from his allies to himself. This effect is invisible.' 'Ignores all new Harmful' = damage_ignore + non_damage_ignore (covers both damage and non-damage harmful) rather than invulnerable, so he stays targetable and the enhanced redirect can legally pull allies' harmful onto him and be harmlessly absorbed. The enhanced redirect is realized via the 'Dead or Alive' mark keying the standing 'Dead or Alive' reflect trigger. 'This effect is invisible' = presentation flag (isHidden). targeting kept 'single' per frozen data; Strategic-only so no target is required (effects self-apply).

skills.name: The Nightmare Rides
skills.note: 'For 2 turns, the Black Knight is invulnerable. During this time, Oathbreaker Strike will target all enemies and is always enhanced.' invulnerable = cannot be targeted by new harmful skills. The 2-turn 'The Nightmare Rides' mark is read by blackknight1's override branch (all enemies + always 25 piercing). targeting kept 'single' per frozen data; Strategic-only so no target is required.

skills.name: Arise!
skills.note: 'Sacrifices this minion to create a Zombie Minion (40 HP, r: Deals 10 damage to 1 enemy.)' Summons one 'Zombie' (template maxHp 40) then defeats self. Order is summon-then-sacrifice so the Zombie is created before the Grave dies; the engine 'defeat' op (to:'self') IS the sacrifice, so no custom fn is needed. Strategic/Instant per frozen classes_active (not Harmful). No hp override on the summon because the Zombie template's maxHp is already 40; the '(40 HP...)' parenthetical just describes the created Zombie's stats, which its own template carries.

passive.name: Curse of Thorns
passive.model: hero-trigger (reactive DoT that grows per skill use)
passive.description: When Maggie uses a skill, she takes 5 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game.
passive.note: Modeled as an accumulating 'Curse of Thorns' stack (one per skill use, permanent) that mirrors a self dot whose per-turn magnitude = 5 x stacks (affliction). The stack is what maggie3/maggie4/maggie5 read; the dot delivers the recurring damage and is name-scoped so maggie5 damage_ignore can suppress it. Oracle says 'rest of the game' (match scope) but the DSL only exposes number|null durations, so null (round-permanent, fresh each battle) is the closest primitive.

triggers.note: Curse of Thorns passive. Re-applying the dot refreshes its magnitude to 5 x current stacks (non-'stacks' statuses refresh per DEFAULT_STACK_POLICY).
Grasping Vines rider: gated by the pending 'Grasping Vines' mark, so inert unless that skill is pending on the acting enemy.
Grasping Vines is cancelled if Maggie is stunned; removing the mark disarms both the mark-guarded scheduled damage and the stun rider.

skills.name: Bramblelash
skills.note: Deal 15, then mark the target (until end of Maggie's next turn ~ duration 2). While marked, the FIRST new damage the target receives grants Maggie Elemental Essence via the maggie1 hero trigger (mark applied AFTER the 15 so the strike itself does not self-trigger; trigger consumes the mark so it fires once per cast). NOTE: the maggie1 essence trigger below must be present in Maggie's hero triggers at runtime.

skills.name: Grasping Vines
skills.note: Prepares on target. 'target invisible to enemy' is real: the Grasping Vines mark and its queued strike are both invisible:true, so redactState hides them from the enemy — they cannot see which of their units is prepared until the delayed hit lands. Next turn deals 15, guarded by the still-present 'Grasping Vines' mark. Stun-on-skill-use rider and cancel-if-Maggie-stunned live in Maggie's hero triggers, both gated by this mark. Damage is mark-guarded so cancellation (mark removal) also suppresses the delayed hit.

skills.name: Thornburst
skills.note: 30 to one enemy; if Maggie has >=3 Curse of Thorns stacks it hits all enemies instead. Declared targeting stays single; the AoE branch fires on the condition.

skills.name: Cursed Resistance
skills.note: 10 permanent (duration null) shield per Curse of Thorns stack.

skills.name: The Thornborn Witch
skills.note: For 2 turns Maggie ignores her own Curse of Thorns damage (damage_ignore name-scoped to 'Curse of Thorns'). Each of those 2 turns she deals damage = her Curse of Thorns damage (5 x stacks) to every other targetable unit (enemies + allies). Modeled as an immediate pulse (cast turn) + one scheduled pulse (next turn). Outgoing type left normal: prose says only 'damage', and it is the amount (not the affliction property) that equals her curse damage.

minions.name: Revenant
minions.note: Fusion-created construct (maggie:lich, Lash of Servitude / maggielich0: 'If Maggie kills an enemy Hero, she creates a Revenant minion with their 3 Basic skills and 25 HP.'). Summoned by the existing Lash of Servitude unitDied trigger; the cloneBasicSkillsOntoRevenant handler then replaces the placeholder with the killed hero's 3 Basic (klass==='basic') skills. Element 'lich' comes from maggielich0 (the fusion that creates it) — the guide's 'grave/lich' resolves to lich, since Lash of Servitude is the lich fusion's passive (maggie also has a separate maggiegrave fusion). maggie currently has NO minions[] array (entry spans roster.authored.json 8173-8949) — a minions[] array must be created to hold this template. Skills authored empty (no invented placeholder id); cloneBasicSkillsOntoRevenant fills them from the killed hero, and the empty-skills state is how the handler finds the fresh Revenant.

passive.name: Deepening Shadows
passive.description: At the end of each of her turns, Laria gains a stack of Deepening Shadows. This effect will only trigger if Laria has fewer than 3 stacks.
passive.note: Deepening Shadows is an accumulating stack resource (permanent/round-scoped) read by laria1/2/3/5. Self-generation caps at 3 via the guard; other skills can push a unit past 3 (up to 4+ for the 'already had 4 stacks' checks).

triggers.note: Deepening Shadows passive.
'or until she uses a new skill' - fires on Laria's next skill use. The Vanish cast that granted the buff does not remove it (the granting skill is excluded as 'a new skill'; Vanish is also Instant).

skills.name: Nightwrap
skills.note: Enemy -> 10 damage, ally -> 10 heal, each +5 per Deepening Shadows stack on the target (measured before the new stack is added). If target holds Elemental Essence, Laria gains Elemental Essence. Then places 1 Deepening Shadows stack on the target.

skills.name: Soothing Night
skills.note: Channel up to 4 turns ('Channel' class). Each channel turn: every ally gains 1 Deepening Shadows stack and heals 5, or heals 10 if they already had >=4 stacks (checked before this turn's stack). The per-turn effect is what the engine repeats for each of the up-to-4 channel turns.

skills.name: Suffocating Night
skills.note: Channel up to 4 turns. Each channel turn: every enemy gains 1 Deepening Shadows stack and takes 5 damage; if they already had >=4 stacks the 5 is dealt as True damage. Effect repeats each channel turn.

skills.name: Vanish
skills.note: 15 Damage Reduction for 3 turns. Early-exit ('or until she uses a new skill') handled by the laria4 hero trigger which removes the named 'Vanish' DR on her next skill use.

skills.name: Nightfall
skills.note: Every character takes 5 damage (enemies) or healing (allies, incl. Laria) per Deepening Shadows stack they have, THEN all become invulnerable for 1 turn. Damage/heal is applied before invulnerable so Nightfall's own hit is not blocked (invulnerable only stops NEW harmful skills per IS_NEW ruling). Stacks are not consumed.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.note: Base frozen prose: 'Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy.' Laria's fusion skill Shadow Cross (larianinja1) frozen prose adds 'Until the end of the turn, Shadow Strike damage to that target is increased by 10', carried on the 'Shadow Cross' mark it places on the target. This skill reads that mark and deals 15 instead of 5 while present (same owner-mark-read pattern as Syl's Talon Rake reading 'To the Skies'). Mark is not consumed, so every clone's strike that turn is empowered until the mark expires.

passive.name: Dream Body
passive.description: Whenever this Hero is the sole target of a skill, he gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Authored as the hero trigger below (source 'Dream Body'): fires on skillUsed when the skill hit exactly one unit and that unit is Xyris.

effect.note: No DSL primitive persistently copies a countered skill onto a summoned unit with a re-elemented Specific cost. Reads the skillDeclared event's skillId, clones it onto the just-summoned Dream Reflection (replacing its placeholder skill), and rewrites Specific costs to Xyris' current element.

No DSL primitive re-runs an arbitrary just-used skill (useSkill needs a static skillId). Flagged as tracked debt for xyris5 in ENGINE_GAPS. Mark is removed first so the echo does not re-trigger this trigger.

skills.name: Enter the Dreamscape
skills.note: 'stuns their helpful skills' -> stun scoped to Helpful only. 'While active, Xyris gains Elemental Essence each turn' -> elemental_essence on Xyris for the 2-turn window (the status yields +1 energy/turn).

skills.name: Twisted Nightmares
skills.note: 'For 1 turn, their AOE skills become single-target.' No DSL primitive converts a unit's targeting; the mark records the 1-turn state and the custom hook enforces the retargeting.

effects.note: While the target holds Twisted Nightmares, its all-* skills resolve against a single target.

skills.name: Somnic Apparition
skills.note: Installs a 1-turn watch on the chosen enemy (mark 'Somnic Watch'). Xyris' standing counter trigger (source 'Somnic Apparition') does the actual counter + Dream Reflection summon + skill-copy. 'This effect is invisible' is the cosmetic isHidden flag (not yet modelled).

skills.name: Echoes of Desire
skills.note: 'The next skill used by target ally will occur twice.' The doubling is a standing trigger + custom echo (see triggers). 'Cannot target Xyris' encoded as the requires gate (target != caster) — really a target-legality rule.

skills.name: Dream Reflection
skills.note: Frozen xyrisminion1: 'A Skill to be replaced with the countered skill.' Effects are empty by design — Somnic Apparition's counter overwrites this skill in place with a copy of the countered enemy skill (Specific cost re-elemented to Xyris' current element) at summon time.

minions.name: Simulacrum
minions.note: Fusion-created construct (xyris:mirror, xyrismirror1 'Simulacrum': 'Xyris targets one ally or enemy and creates a Simulacrum minion that possesses their Basic skills. Simulacrums are created with 30 HP and their specific costs are the same as Xyris's.'). No skills of its own: the EXISTING cloneBasicSkillsOntoSimulacrum handler overwrites the whole skills array with deep-clones of the target's Basic (klass==='basic') skills and re-elements specific costs to Xyris at summon time. Empty skills[] follows the Boulder pattern; this handler does not look up any placeholder id, so none is authored. Element 'shadow' = Xyris's base element (matches the frozen Dream Reflection minion). Append to xyris's existing minions[] array, next to Dream Reflection (roster.authored.json ~9250).

passive.name: Dwindling Flame
passive.description: Fate can only be healed by his own skills and effects. While his HP is at or above 50, allies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 more non-Affliction damage. While his HP is below 50, enemies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 less non-Affliction damage.
passive.note: Split into three hero triggers (source 'Dwindling Flame'): (1) roundStart applies heal_lock(only-healer=self) — 'healed only by his own skills'. (2)+(3) are the static conditional aura, refreshed each turnStart as outgoing_damage_mod on Fox-Fire-marked units gated on Fate's live HP vs 50. outgoing_damage_mod is normal/piercing-only, a close read of 'non-Affliction' (which also includes true damage); the 1-turn refresh keeps it synced to Fate's HP.

triggers.note: 'once per skill' is automatic (one skillUsed = one fire). Target-side clause ('on Fate or his allies') is simplified: any enemy Harmful skill during the window retaliates, since harmful skills target Fate's side.

'the first time Fate or an ally would die' -> intercept the first unitDied among protected heroes; consume by removing the window from everyone. Bonus heal = 5 * (units marked Fox Fire). 'once per round' -> round-permanent 'TINTE Spent' lock (clears at round end) + fate6.requires gate.

skills.name: Fox Fire
skills.note: Applies the Fox Fire mark (4 turns). All conferred behaviour (use/receive Harmful -> 5 dmg/heal; skills on Fate -> Essence; double under Vulpus channels) lives in the standing 'Fox Fire' triggers. 'Refreshes if applied on an already affected target' = refresh policy on re-apply.

skills.name: Will-o'-wisp
skills.note: Retaliation window handled by the 'Will-o'-wisp' trigger.

skills.name: Vulpus Incendia
skills.note: Channeled: re-runs each of Fate's turns until interrupted. 'Fox Fire deals double damage' is read by the Fox Fire triggers via the channeling status (name 'fate3').

skills.name: Vulpus Crystallia
skills.note: klass=fusion per frozen skill_class, though it is a base-kit slot. Channeled heal; 'Fox Fire gives double healing' read via channeling status (name 'fate4').

skills.name: Fox's Cunning
skills.note: Applies the 1-turn 'Fox's Cunning' window mark to Fate; the standing trigger marks any enemy who uses a new skill with Fox Fire. 'This effect is invisible' = cosmetic isHidden (not yet modelled).

skills.name: This Is Not The End
skills.note: Arms a 2-turn revive ward on Fate + allied heroes; the interception + 40-HP revive + Fox-Fire bonus heal + once-per-round lock live in the 'This Is Not The End' trigger. requires blocks recast only after the ward has fired this round.

passive.name: The Devil's Price
passive.description: Whenever a target triggers one of Scratch's Deal skills, Scratch gains Elemental Essence. When one of his Deal skills expires without being triggered, its target gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Realized distributively across the Deal skills rather than as a single standalone trigger, because the engine offers no generic 'match any of these named marks' condition. (1) 'target triggers a Deal -> Scratch gains Essence' is the applyStatus{elemental_essence} to self inside each Deal's skillUsed reaction trigger below. (2) 'a Deal expires untriggered -> its target gains Essence' is the onExpire:[applyStatus{elemental_essence} to target] carried on each Deal-mark; onExpire fires only on a natural duration lapse, so a Deal that WAS triggered (its mark removed early by the reaction) never grants the target Essence. Each Deal is one mark applied to the target for the Deal window + a standing Scratch-owned reaction trigger gated on that mark. The ultimate 'Deal: Know Your Fate' has no 'use a skill' trigger and so does not participate in this economy (see its note).

triggers.note: The 'if they use a new skill' clause of scratch1. Fires when the Deal's target (eventSource) uses any new skill while marked. Suppress the 20 Affliction punishment if a Faustian Bargain flagged this Deal 'no-trigger-to-allies'. The applyStatus{elemental_essence} to self is the passive's Scratch-Essence clause. Removing the mark consumes the Deal so it fires once and its onExpire (target Essence) does not run.

The positive half of scratch2: 'target Hero's next Helpful skill will heal its targets for 15 HP and make them Invulnerable for 1 turn'. This MUST resolve before the punishment trigger below (array order = firing order) so the boon reads its mark before the punishment removes it. Uses custom because the augment needs to (a) verify the used skill is Helpful and (b) reach that skill's targets (eventTargets) with heal+invulnerable -- and skillUsed carries no class tags (only skillDeclared does, which does not fire react triggers), so 'Helpful' cannot be tag-gated here in pure DSL.

effect.note: If the skill just used (ctx.event.skillId on eventSource) carries the 'Helpful' tag, heal each of its targets (eventTargets) 15 and apply invulnerable duration 1 to them. Engine gap: no react-fireable event exposes class tags, so this cannot be expressed as a tag-gated if/heal tree.

triggers.note: The trigger half of scratch2: 'If they use a new skill, this effect will end and that Hero will be permanently Isolated.' Removing the Boon mark ends the augment; permanent Isolated = duration null (round-scoped). Suppressed against allies when Faustian flagged this Deal. applyStatus{elemental_essence} to self is the passive.

The 'if they use a new skill, they will be stunned for 1 turn' clause of scratch3. The cost discount is a separate cost_mod status that lives out its own duration and is NOT removed here. applyStatus{elemental_essence} to self is the passive. Punishment suppressed vs allies if Faustian-flagged.

scratch5's reactive window: 'any enemy who uses a new skill on him will be marked for 1 turn.' Gated on Scratch holding the 1-turn Disarming Pitch self-mark. 'Marked' is the mark Scratch's Deals are allowed to target (a targeting ruling, noted on scratch5).

skills.name: Deal: Defeat Your Enemies
skills.note: Target Hero deals 10 more non-Affliction damage for 1 turn (outgoing_damage_mod, which the engine already restricts to normal/piercing).
