Lays 'Deal: Defeat Your Enemies' mark for the 1-turn window; its onExpire grants the target Essence if it lapses untriggered (passive). The 'if they use a new skill -> 20 Affliction' punishment is the standing reaction trigger of the same name. Faustian handling: skip the positive vs enemies; flag 'no-trigger' vs allies. The mark's duration and the outgoing_damage_mod are separate statuses.

skills.name: Deal: Save Your Friends
skills.note: For 1 turn, target Hero's next Helpful skill will heal its targets 15 and make them Invulnerable 1 turn (the 'Boon: Save Your Friends' mark, consumed by the boon reaction trigger). 'If they use a new skill, this effect ends and that Hero is permanently Isolated' = the punishment reaction trigger. Faustian: skip the boon vs enemies; flag 'no-trigger' vs allies (suppresses the Isolate).

skills.name: Deal: Realize Your Potential
skills.note: Until the end of their next turn (duration 1, applier-anchored), target's skills cost 1 less Specific AND 1 less Generic — a cost_mod with per-channel genericDelta:-1/specificDelta:-1, applied to each channel independently (floored, no cross-channel spill) by effectiveCost. 'If they use a new skill, stunned 1 turn' = the reaction trigger. Faustian: skip discount vs enemies; flag 'no-trigger' vs allies.

skills.name: Faustian Bargain
skills.note: Scratch's next Deal will not apply its positive effect to enemies, and will not apply its Triggered effect to allies. Modeled as a self-mark that scratch1/2/3 read at cast time: each Deal skips its positive when (Faustian AND target is an enemy), and stamps a 'Faustian: no-trigger' flag on the target when (Faustian AND target is an ally) which the Deal's reaction trigger honors by suppressing its punishment. Each Deal consumes the Faustian mark at the end of its effects (removeStatus), so it applies to exactly the next Deal. Duration null = persists until that next Deal consumes it (round-scoped). Does not modify the ultimate 'Deal: Know Your Fate', whose structure has no positive/triggered split.

skills.name: Disarming Pitch
skills.note: For 1 turn: 10 Shield on Scratch, and a 1-turn 'Disarming Pitch' self-window during which the reaction trigger stamps 'Marked' (1 turn) on any enemy who uses a new skill on him. Final clause 'Scratch's Deal skills always apply to marked Heroes' is a TARGETING-LEGALITY ruling (it lets his Helpful-tagged Deals legally target enemies bearing the 'Marked' mark); target legality lives in the scheduler's legalTargets, not in the effect DSL, so it is recorded here as a ruling rather than an effect node.

skills.name: Deal: Know Your Fate
skills.note: For 3 turns the target ignores non-damage effects (non_damage_ignore, 3) and their skills have no cost (cost_mod magnitude -99: effectiveCost clamps generic and specific at 0, so a large negative zeroes any real cost). At the end of the 3 turns the target is killed -- the 'Know Your Fate' mark's onExpire runs defeat on its holder (onExpire caster=Scratch, target=holder). This Deal has no 'use a skill' trigger, so The Devil's Price's trigger/expiry-Essence economy does not attach to it, and Faustian Bargain's positive/triggered clauses do not map onto it.

passive.name: Dune Stalker
passive.description: Aramao deals 5 more damage to the enemy Hero directly across from him, and he gains Elemental Essence whenever he damages them.
passive.note: One damageDealt trigger, gated on Aramao (eventSource==self) hitting the across enemy (eventTarget==across). It (1) applies the +5 and (2) grants Aramao Essence. The +5 is modeled as healthLoss (flat, ignores Shield/DR) rather than a second damage node ON PURPOSE: the engine has no scoped-positional outgoing_damage_mod (that status is global, not per-target), and a real damage node would re-emit damageDealt and re-fire this very trigger. healthLoss emits no damageDealt, so it delivers a clean one-shot +5 with no self-retrigger. Fidelity caveat: being non-damage, the +5 does not itself feed damage-keyed reactions.

effect.note: 'deals 5 more damage to the across enemy' -- see passive note for why healthLoss.

triggers.note: aramao3 counter for the case where the target was across. Standing counter gated on the per-target trap mark; NOT 'once' (once would delete it from Aramao permanently and break re-casts). Removing the mark makes it a one-shot 'first non-Strategic skill they use' -- after it counters, the mark is gone so nothing else is countered, and if the enemy never uses a non-Strategic skill the 1-turn mark simply lapses. The declared skill is negated automatically because kind=counter.
aramao3 counter for the case where the target was NOT across: counter the first Strategic skill they use. Same one-shot-via-mark-removal pattern as above.

aramao6: 'For 3 turns, all allied Heroes are Veiled at the end of each turn.' Fires on every turn-end while the 3-turn 'Trial of the Sands' self-mark on Aramao persists, re-veiling all allied heroes (includes Aramao). Veil duration 2 comfortably spans until the next re-veil; when the Trial mark lapses the re-veiling stops.

aramao6: 'Aramao will use Desert Knife on any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him.' Retaliates with Desert Knife (useSkill aramao1) on the attacker who targeted Aramao with a Harmful skill (eventHasTag 'Harmful' gates out non-Harmful skills). useSkill runs aramao1's effects inline and emits no skillUsed, so this does not recurse.

skills.name: Desert Knife
skills.note: Deals 10 Piercing to target. If the target enemy is NOT directly across from Aramao, he swaps positions with the ally that IS across from that enemy (the teammate occupying the target's slot), leaving Aramao across from the target. 'Using this skill does not break Veiled' is doesNotBreakVeil:true: performAction now removes a caster's Veiled on Harmful skill use, and this opt-out exempts Desert Knife.

then.note: swapPositions(self, <ally whose slot == target.slot>). Requires custom: no selector/value expresses 'my teammate in the target's slot' -- there is no target-relative 'across' selector and no 'slot' Value ref to compare slots inside a forEach. The native fn finds the caster's living hero teammate sharing target.slot and swaps their slot fields; if none exists it is a no-op.

skills.name: Sand Quake
skills.note: Deals 10 Piercing to all enemies and extends every Veiled effect on the field by 2 turns. 'does not break Veiled' is doesNotBreakVeil:true (performAction breaks Veiled on Harmful use; this exempts it). Frozen targeting_type was 'all'; recorded as 'all-enemies' since the damage is enemies-only and the Veil-extension uses an explicit selector.

skills.name: Mirage Trap
skills.note: Targets an enemy Hero for 1 turn (this skill is hidden/concealed -- an isHidden presentation flag with no effect-DSL representation, noted). If that enemy is directly across from Aramao, arm the counter against their first NON-Strategic skill; otherwise arm it against their first Strategic skill. The counters themselves are the two standing 'Mirage Trap' counter triggers, gated on whichever mark this cast applies.

skills.name: Desert Veil
skills.note: Targets an allied Hero or Aramao. If targeting Aramao (target==caster): Veil Aramao and a random OTHER allied Hero for 2 turns. If targeting an ally: Veil that ally and Aramao for 2 turns and swap their formation positions.

skills.name: Heart of the Desert
skills.note: Heal each Hero adjacent to Aramao for 15; if there is exactly ONE adjacent Hero, also heal Aramao for 15 (so: 1 adjacent -> that ally + Aramao; 2 adjacent -> both allies, not Aramao). 'This effect Bypasses' -> added the Bypassing tag (present in the oracle prose though absent from the frozen classes_active list) so the heal ignores Isolated/Invulnerable targeting blocks. With 0 living adjacent allies nothing heals (prose is silent on that case).

skills.name: Trial of the Sands
skills.note: Installs the 3-turn 'Trial of the Sands' window on Aramao and immediately shuffles his team's formation once. While the window is up, two standing triggers fire: (re-veil) veils all allied heroes at each turn-end, and (retaliate) uses Desert Knife on any enemy who uses a Harmful skill on Aramao. Frozen targeting_type was 'all'; recorded as 'all-allies' since it acts on Aramao's team. 'After being used, Aramao's team randomly swaps places once' = the shuffleTeam below.

passive.name: Eyes of Vengeance
passive.description: Enemy Heroes who use non-Invisible Harmful skills on Sera or her allies gain a stack of Eyes of Vengeance.
passive.note: Modeled as an on-skillUsed trigger. 'On Sera or her allies' = a declared target on Sera's team (isFaction ally on eventTargets). 'non-Invisible' is a real filter now: {not:{eventHidden:true}} reads the used skill's isHidden flag (the skillUsed event carries hidden), so the passive does not fire off the 20 inherently-Invisible skills. sera4 (Scan) extends the same passive to enemy Strategic skills for 1 turn via the 'Scan of the All-Knowing' mark, which this trigger's condition ORs in.

skills.name: Synthetic Skyblade
skills.note: Base: 15 to target; if the target carries Eyes of Vengeance, consume 1 stack for +10 damage and Sera gains Elemental Essence. Divinity Engine (sera6) augment, active while the 'Divinity Engine' mark is on Sera: consume 1 EXTRA Eyes of Vengeance stack if one remains, and grant Sera Shield equal to the damage dealt (15 base +10 if the marked-bonus fired). Shield uses nominal skill damage (no Value ref exists for post-mitigation damage dealt).

skills.name: Energized Wingstorm
skills.note: 15 Piercing to the enemy team; for each enemy marked by Eyes of Vengeance, consume 1 stack and reduce this skill's cooldown by 1. Iterating all enemies with an inner stackCount>=1 guard (rather than a `with` filter) avoids counting a lingering magnitude-0 stack. CAVEAT: performAction sets currentCd = cooldown AFTER a skill's effects run (scheduler ~L414), so a skill reducing its OWN cooldown mid-cast is currently clobbered by the engine; modifyCooldown is the correct primitive but needs the engine to apply self-cd post-effects (or fold pending self-cd deltas) for the reduction to land.

skills.name: Heavenly Parry
skills.note: Installs a 1-turn invisible punish on the target enemy: the reaction lives as an always-on Sera trigger (source 'Heavenly Parry') that reads this mark - when the marked enemy next uses a Harmful skill it takes 25 Piercing and gains an ADDITIONAL Eyes of Vengeance stack (additional to the passive's), then the mark is consumed (one-shot; the duration-1 mark also lapses if unused). 'If the target was already marked, Sera gains Elemental Essence' resolves immediately on cast. 'This effect is invisible' has no per-effect flag in the DSL.

skills.name: Scan of the All-Knowing
skills.note: For 1 turn, Eyes of Vengeance also triggers from enemy Strategic skills. Modeled as a 1-turn 'Scan of the All-Knowing' mark on Sera; the Eyes of Vengeance passive trigger already ORs in (Strategic AND this mark). 'This effect is invisible' - no per-effect invisible flag exists. Frozen targeting_type was single(defaulted); the effect only touches Sera, so the nominal target is ignored (the skill carries no Harmful/Helpful tag, so no legal target is required).

skills.name: Proactivity Protocol
skills.note: Sera takes 20 True damage (ignores the shield below), gains 20 Shield, and heals the target ally for 20. Frozen classes_active gave no Helpful tag, so targeting legality is not ally-restricted; 'Target ally' is the intended nominal target.

skills.name: Divinity Engine
skills.note: 'For her next 2 turns' = duration 2. non_damage_ignore = 'ignores non-damage effects'; the 'Divinity Engine' mark is the flag Synthetic Skyblade (sera1) reads for its extra-stack-consume + shield-equal-to-damage augment. NOT captured in the static cost: 'This skill's cost is decreased by S (specific) for each of Sera's dead allies' - a dynamic, per-cast, skill-scoped cost reduction; neither the static cost field nor the holder-wide cost_mod status can express skill-scoped dynamic cost. This is the tracked 'scoped cost' fidelity debt; static cost left at {generic:0, specific:3}.

passive.name: The Storm Builds
passive.description: Galazax's damaging skills apply a stack of The Storm Builds. Galazax gains Elemental Essence if he uses a skill while Channeling.
passive.note: Clause 1 = an on-damageDealt trigger applying 1 'The Storm Builds' stack to each enemy Galazax damages (fires per damaged target, so AoE/multi-hit and channel ticks build per target; skills that also apply stacks - galazax4, galazax6 - stack on top, which galazax6's 'extra stack' wording confirms). Clause 2 = an on-skillUsed trigger granting Elemental Essence when Galazax uses a skill while a channeling status is active.

skills.name: The Sky Darkens
skills.note: Channel skill: the engine re-runs these effects (5 Piercing to all enemies) at each of Galazax's turns until interrupted (indefinite; channelTurns null). Each tick is Galazax dealing damage, so the passive lays a Storm Builds stack per enemy per turn. 'Cannot be used while active' = requires not already channeling galazax1.

skills.name: Lightning Strikes
skills.note: 10 to the target and 5 to a random enemy (the pick is over all living enemies and may land on the primary target). Each hit is a separate damageDealt, so the passive applies a Storm Builds stack to each enemy struck.

skills.name: Pressure Rises
skills.note: Moves all The Storm Builds from the target to Galazax: copy the target's count onto self, resolve the >=4 stun and >=2 Piercing (both read the pristine pre-move count), then wipe the target's stacks. Stun is checked BEFORE the 5 Piercing on purpose - that damage triggers the passive (a fresh stack on the target), so reading the stun threshold first keeps it off the pristine count. The final wipe clears that fresh passive stack too, so the target ends at 0 ('moves ALL stacks'). doesNotInterrupt: does not break the Sky Darkens channel.

skills.name: The Heavens Speak
skills.note: Consumes all of Galazax's The Storm Builds (N): deal 10 + 5*N to the target, apply N stacks to the target, then wipe Galazax's stacks. Both N-reads (damage amount, applied count) precede the self-wipe and read self (untouched by the target-side passive stack), so N is stable. The damage additionally triggers the passive (+1 stack on the target), so the target nets N+1 - consistent with the kit's stacking design.

skills.name: Thunder Deafens
skills.note: Untargetable + ignores all damage for 1 turn. doesNotInterrupt: keeps the Sky Darkens channel running.

skills.name: The Vortex Consumes
skills.note: Cast-gate (requires): mid-'The Sky Darkens' channel (channeling name=galazax1) AND >=10 The Storm Builds, which are consumed via modifyStatus -10. '15 Piercing to all enemies each turn for 3 turns' = one immediate hit plus two scheduled repeats (delayTurns 1 & 2, firing at Galazax's next two turn-ends), because the skill is tagged Instant (not Channel) in the frozen data, so it can't install an engine channel. Scheduled selectors ({faction:'enemies'}) re-resolve live at fire time. 'Applies an extra stack to all targets' = the +1 addStack per hit; the passive adds another per hit ('extra' confirms passive+1).

passive.name: Prismari Rangers
passive.description: Prisma Trinity is split between three members: Prisma Crimson, Prisma Azure, and Prisma Saffron. This Hero is Untargetable and ignores damage and Harmful effects, and is considered to be dead when all three members are dead.
passive.note: Modeled as a hero roundStart trigger (shell statuses untargetable + damage_ignore + non_damage_ignore, a RangersAlive=3 stack, and summoning the three Ranger minions) plus a unitDied death-link trigger on each Ranger template. 'Ignores damage' = damage_ignore; 'ignores Harmful effects' = non_damage_ignore; all round-permanent (duration null). Hero maxHp 100 is a nominal shell value (the shell is undamageable and dies only via defeat); effective survivability is the three 65-HP Rangers = 195 (MINION_HP_SOURCE ruling).

triggers.note: Realizes the passive each fresh-battle round (startRound clears statuses/minions then emits roundStart): re-arms the undamageable/untargetable/harm-immune shell, sets RangersAlive=3, and summons the three Rangers. Linked death is completed by each Ranger's own unitDied trigger (decrements RangersAlive on the summoner; defeats Trinity at 0).

skills.name: Prisma Lens
skills.note: Abstract category header on the Trinity shell. Oracle: 'Targets 1 enemy. Members of the Prismari can target the user of this skill to reflect their own skills to the targeted enemy, amplified. Reflecting skills this way gives Prisma Trinity Elemental Essence.' The concrete per-Ranger versions are the minion skills Ruby Lens / Sapphire Lens / Citrine Lens; the shared reflect + Trinity-Essence behaviour is authored on each Ranger's reflect trigger. No standalone effect tree on the shell (not invented).

skills.name: Prisma Maneuver
skills.note: Abstract category header on the Trinity shell. Oracle: 'The Prismari have a variety of reactive and defensive skills they can use on either themselves or another Prismari Ranger. Prisma Vault, Prisma Whirl, Prisma Launch.' The concrete behaviour is the minion skills Prisma Vault / Prisma Whirl / Prisma Launch. No standalone effect tree (not invented).

skills.name: Chroma Magica
skills.note: Abstract category header on the Trinity shell. Oracle: 'The Prismari can fire magical attacks at their enemies or other Prismari Rangers. Crimson Crash, Sonata Azure, Saffron Beam.' The concrete behaviour is the minion skills Crimson Crash / Sonata Azure / Saffron Beam (aiming one at a lensing Ranger triggers the Lens reflect). No standalone effect tree (not invented).

skills.name: Ruby Lens
skills.note: Oracle: 'Prisma Crimson prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the targeted enemy receives 5 Affliction damage.' Sets up the redirect (marks). The +5 Affliction bonus and Trinity's Essence gain live on Prisma Crimson's reflect trigger.

skills.name: Prisma Vault
skills.note: Oracle: 'Prisma Crimson becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If used on another Prisma Ranger that is using their Lens, the enemy they are targeting is marked for 1 turn.' The +15 Crimson Crash damage vs Prisma Vault-marked enemies is authored on Crimson Crash. 'The enemy they are targeting' = the enemy marked 'Lens Target'.

skills.name: Crimson Crash
skills.note: Oracle: 'Deals 15 damage to target enemy.' Plus the Prisma Vault rider: '+15 more damage to enemies marked by Prisma Vault' (total 30 if marked). May be aimed at a lensing Ranger to be reflected at the Lens target.

triggers.note: The shared Prisma Lens reflect (Ruby): when a Prismari ally aims a Harmful skill at this lensing Ranger, resolveDeclaration redirects it to the enemy marked 'Lens Target', deals the +5 Affliction bonus, grants Prisma Trinity Elemental Essence, and consumes the 'Lens' setup (one redirect). Strategic maneuvers aimed at a lensing Ranger are NOT redirected (gated on the Harmful tag) so their buddy clauses resolve. 'amplified' has no magnitude in the oracle; the per-color bonus is the amplification.

Prisma Whirl base: the FIRST enemy to act while this Ranger holds the primed mark takes 10 Piercing; the mark is consumed (first-only). NOTE: skillUsed carries no tags, so the oracle's 'Harmful' qualifier cannot be gated via eventHasTag here -- it punishes the first enemy skill use in the window.

Prisma Whirl upgraded (cast on a lensing Ranger): the mark is NOT consumed, so it damages ANY number of enemies that act during the 1-turn window. Same tagless-skillUsed limitation as the base punish.

skills.name: Sapphire Lens
skills.note: Oracle: 'Prisma Azure prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the affected ally is healed for 10 HP. This skill cannot be countered.' The +10 heal to the redirected ally and Trinity's Essence gain live on Prisma Azure's reflect trigger; 'cannot be countered' = Uncounterable tag.

skills.name: Prisma Whirl
skills.note: Oracle: 'For one turn, the first enemy to use a Harmful skill will receive 10 Piercing damage. If used on another Prismari Ranger that is using their Lens, that unit becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and Prisma Whirl's effect can damage any number of enemies.' Primes a retaliation mark on the target Ranger (self or ally); the buddy branch upgrades it to the 'Barrage' mark (any-number) and grants Invulnerable. The 10 Piercing retaliation fires from the Ranger templates' whirl triggers.

skills.name: Sonata Azure
skills.note: Oracle: 'Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn.' Scoped stun (mode 'only' on the Strategic tag) stops only the target's Strategic skills. May be reflected via a lensing Ranger.

triggers.note: The shared Prisma Lens reflect (Sapphire): redirects the ally's Harmful skill to the enemy marked 'Lens Target', heals the redirected ally (eventSource) 10 HP, grants Prisma Trinity Elemental Essence, and consumes the 'Lens' setup. Strategic maneuvers aimed at a lensing Ranger are NOT redirected (Harmful-gated). 'amplified' has no magnitude in the oracle; the per-color bonus is the amplification.

Prisma Whirl base: the FIRST enemy to act while this Ranger holds the primed mark takes 10 Piercing; the mark is consumed (first-only). NOTE: skillUsed carries no tags, so 'Harmful' cannot be gated via eventHasTag -- it punishes the first enemy skill use in the window.
Prisma Whirl upgraded (cast on a lensing Ranger): the mark is NOT consumed, so it damages ANY number of enemies that act during the 1-turn window.

skills.name: Citrine Lens
skills.note: Oracle: 'Prisma Saffron prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the targeted enemy deals 5 less damage for 1 turn.' The -5 outgoing weaken on the enemy and Trinity's Essence gain live on Prisma Saffron's reflect trigger; 'cannot be countered' = Uncounterable tag.

skills.name: Prisma Launch
skills.note: Oracle: 'Until the end of the next turn, Prisma Saffron's skills will Bypass against target enemy. If used on another Prisma Ranger that is using their Lens, their skills will also Bypass during this time and they become invulnerable for one turn.' The target is marked 'Prisma Launch: Bypass' (dur 1 = 'until end of next turn'); prismaLaunchBypass then applies a conditional_bypass keyed to that mark — to Saffron for an enemy target (her skills ignore DR+Shield vs the marked enemy), or to a lensing-ally Ranger target (their skills also Bypass), who the if-branch also makes Invulnerable. Bypass = the canonical ignore-DR+Shield (bypassesAgainst, damage.ts).

skills.name: Saffron Beam
skills.note: Oracle: 'Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.' Taunt forces the target onto Saffron (unitRef 'self'). May be reflected via a lensing Ranger.

triggers.note: The shared Prisma Lens reflect (Citrine): redirects the ally's Harmful skill to the enemy marked 'Lens Target', applies -5 outgoing_damage_mod (deals 5 less) for 1 turn to that enemy, grants Prisma Trinity Elemental Essence, and consumes the 'Lens' setup. Strategic maneuvers aimed at a lensing Ranger are NOT redirected (Harmful-gated). 'amplified' has no magnitude in the oracle; the per-color bonus is the amplification.

Prisma Whirl base: the FIRST enemy to act while this Ranger holds the primed mark takes 10 Piercing; consumed (first-only). NOTE: skillUsed carries no tags, so 'Harmful' cannot be gated via eventHasTag -- punishes the first enemy skill use in the window.
Prisma Whirl upgraded (cast on a lensing Ranger): the mark is NOT consumed, so it damages ANY number of enemies that act during the 1-turn window.
